concepts.label: Inter-Sync Gateway Replication (ISGR)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused from configuration-schema-database.json, same batch, minted there - this page is its dedicated Admin REST API reference. Checked explicitly against the registry's xdcr:* family (xdcr:reference, xdcr:replication, xdcr:replication-filter, etc. - Couchbase SERVER's cluster-to-cluster replication mechanism, a different product and topology). This page never mentions XDCR, Couchbase Server-side replication, or any cross-cluster mechanism at all - it is entirely self-contained to Sync Gateway node-to-node replication. No source page in this batch states a relationship between ISGR and XDCR, so sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication is kept fully separate from every xdcr:* concept per the standing no-silent-merge rule.

concepts.label: System Certificate Pool (ISGR CA certificates)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - Sync Gateway's own OS-level trusted-certificate pool (SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR on Linux, the system root store on Windows) that must carry the CA certificate for an ISGR peer's TLS connection. Deliberately NOT reused as cert:trust-store (Couchbase Server's own node-level trust store concept, defined as 'the store of trusted CA certificates a Couchbase node consults') per the round's explicit instruction to check wording before assuming a Server-side TLS/cert concept transfers - this page describes a Go-runtime/OS certificate pool mechanism with its own distinct configuration surface (environment variables or OS certificate store), not Couchbase Server's inbox-directory/UI-driven certificate mechanism at all

notable_absence.finding: Confirming the round's specific near-miss watch: this page never uses the word 'XDCR', never mentions Couchbase Server-side cross-cluster replication, and never draws any comparison between ISGR and any Server mechanism. The only replication concept on the page is Sync Gateway's own node-to-node ISGR. This absence is itself the evidence for the near-miss resolution recorded on sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication's own concept note: with nothing on this page (or any other page read in this batch) stating a relationship, the correct move per the standing no-silent-merge rule is to keep sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication and the xdcr:* family entirely separate, not to fold or alias them.

cross_component_finding: This page's schema block is field-for-field identical to configuration-schema-database.json's `replications.replication_id` sub-schema (see that record's cross_component_finding for the full comparison) - same 19 fields, same defaults, same descriptions, in the same order. Two settings (conflict_resolution_type/custom_conflict_resolver's dependency, and enable_delta_sync's dependency on database-level delta_sync.enabled) are stated in identical prose on both pages, which is why they are recorded on both records rather than only once - both pages independently make the claim verbatim.
cross_product_finding: sgw:isgr-ca-certificate-pool is a genuinely SGW-specific certificate mechanism (an OS/runtime-level trust pool configured via environment variables or the OS certificate store) with no equivalent surface among the registry's cert:* family, all of which describe Couchbase Server's own inbox-directory/UI/REST-driven certificate management. This was checked deliberately (per the round's explicit instruction on this exact page) and no reuse was made - the two are structurally different delivery mechanisms for conceptually similar CA-trust needs, kept separate because no page states they are the same thing.
